authority: Only the private original AWS observe_ec2_instance consumer enables the class. It is not selected by public input, any other provider, create, retirement, callback or generic adapter call.

classification.HTTP: Actual same complete bounded HTTP response/read/close and original context checks remain mandatory. SDK Envelope is duplicate-safe/closed; known optional SDK transport metadata is allowed; bare-RPC compatibility remains.
classification.RPC: Only exact closed nonduplicate canonical {ok:false,error:{code:execute_failed,message:original_ec2_readiness_native_read_failed}}, with no data, becomes the private static error class.
classification.meaning: The existing adapter class reports native-read unavailability, including AWS eventual propagation or unavailable SDK/XML result. It provides no observation or proof. It does not claim that each event is precisely InvalidInstanceID.NotFound.
classification.public_errors: Existing detail-free errors stay unchanged; no provider error text or response body enters the retained typed class.

continuation.failed_reads: Return zero proof/Pending only for this class while guard/context remain live. All other RPC errors, malformed Core JSON/envelopes, mismatched parsed identity/spec/physical proof/health and cancelled contexts fail immediately.
continuation.qualification: No unavailable reply can provide native identity, signed create witness, enrollment, useful capacity, completion or clean-cycle credit.
continuation.unchanged: Exactly one original ensure/Create/settlement; existing accepted receipt/ID/birth/action joins; original guard/owner/lease/catalog checks and one-second read ticker; original context deadline is never replaced or extended.

declared_CI.existing_step: Actual original provider source contracts and default refusal

scope: Source-owned original AWS creation observer may await unavailable native reads on its one settled original creation, within the unchanged original provisioning deadline.
validation: Static text/JSON/SHA/AST/gofmt/diff only plus existing deterministic pure Source-token inventory generator. Independent review and actual exact-Source CI remain required.
